# `config.set`

Set a machine-local configuration value (never profile-pack or governed-repo data).

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `reversible`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice config-set`
- **MCP tool:** `config_set` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | `str` | required |  |
| `value` | `str` | required |  |

## Examples

```
operator-voice config-set --key some_flag --value true
```
